items.question: What is the maximum amount of the non-refundable tax credit under Phase 1 of the UAE's Research and Development (R&D) Tax Incentives Programme?
items.gold: The non-refundable tax credit is up to 50 per cent of eligible R&D expenditure, capped at AED 5 million.
items.fact: R&D tax credit capped at AED 5 million under Phase 1

items.question: Under the UAE's R&D Tax Incentives Programme (Ministerial Decision No. 24 of 2026), what must an R&D activity's outcome or means be, to count as a qualified activity?
items.gold: It must be uncertain, meaning the outcome or means of achieving it are not known in advance.
items.fact: Qualified R&D activity must be uncertain, outcome unknown in advance
